what_the_class_is: OD -> Delay as a whole: the overdrive's drive stage as far as its pan, then a line a side with a damped loop, one time for both, balanced against a dry path, then the output level and the tone pair every insertion type ends in.

era.when: Mid nineteen-nineties, a custom fixed-point DSP running its effects at 32 kHz with a small control processor beside it.
what_that_implies: A combination is two of the machine's single effects run one into the other in one program, and the cheapest way to build one is to reuse each single effect's code and tables as they stand, which is what the flanger half of these types was measured to do.

What a combination has to decide for itself is the wiring between the two: which signal the second effect's balance mixes its own output against, and where the one shared tone pair and output level go.
Times, rates, levels and corners are tables indexed by the byte, as the classes that read them closed on; a whole-type model borrows those tables rather than fitting its own.
era.would_be_wrong_if: A part named after a single effect came back with a delay, a rate or a loop of its own at settings nothing here was built on, or the dry end of the second part's balance sounded as neither the first part's output nor the chain's own input.

candidates.reading: The delay balances against the drive's panned output, so the drive is on both of its paths; the tone pair ends the chain after the level.
candidates.predicts: At the dry end of the balance byte the drive's output alone, and a shelf's gain the same whatever the drive is doing.

candidates.reading: The delay balances against the drive's panned output, so the drive is on both of its paths; the tone pair is on the chain's input, ahead of the drive.
candidates.predicts: At the dry end of the balance byte the drive's output alone, and a shelf's gain spread into the drive's orders, so a boosted band grows harmonics above it rather than only rising.

candidates.reading: The delay balances against the chain's own input, so the drive is inside its wet path only; the tone pair ends the chain after the level.
candidates.predicts: At the dry end of the balance byte the undriven input alone, and a shelf's gain the same whatever the drive is doing.

candidates.reading: The delay balances against the chain's own input, so the drive is inside its wet path only; the tone pair is on the chain's input, ahead of the drive.
candidates.predicts: At the dry end of the balance byte the undriven input alone, and a shelf's gain spread into the drive's orders, so a boosted band grows harmonics above it rather than only rising.

what_no_candidate_here_predicts: What the Amp and Amp Sw bytes do: the amp table is a readout with no filter, and a filter fitted to its profiles would be the profiles.
Anything with a state in the drive's curve.
Whether the stereo delay's damping pole reaches this type's HF byte: carried unmeasured.
